# Comet

[![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-green.svg)](https://ci.example/comet)

A fast thing.

## Features

- Fast
- Small

## Getting Started

```bash
npm i comet-core@2.0.0
```

```js
import { comet } from 'comet-core';
comet();
```

Expected output:

```
comet ready
```

### Advanced

More options in `comet.config.js`.
